title: Existence in W^{2,2} and a priori estimate for the stationary Navier-Stokes system with nonlinear damping at negative mu (Theorem 1.2)
author: Alireza Khatib; Abbas Moameni; Somayeh Mousavinasr
work: Variational approach for the n-dimensional stationary Navier-Stokes equations with a damping term
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations 2026 (2026), No. 01, pp. 1--13; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.01; publisher version
difficulty_reason: Beyond the cited Ky Fan minimax lemma, the Stokes resolvent estimate and the Agmon-Douglis-Nirenberg W^{2,p} elliptic estimate, the proof has to build a source-local mechanism: a convex weakly closed ball K(r) in W^{2,2}, weak lower semicontinuity of the article's Lagrangian M in the two imbedding regimes n<=4 and 5<=n<=7, and a self-consistent radius r that returns the auxiliary solution into K(r) so that v-bar=u-bar. It then bootstraps the a priori estimate (1.3) in W^{2,2} under a small-force condition, which is well outside an ordinary qualifying-exam treatment of stationary Navier-Stokes. The analytic ingredients are classical but their assembly is paper-specific and coercivity-free, so the unit is H2 rather than H3.
